body:
## E1 step 9 / disable path: A and B halves observed with a deterministic entry; C half still not reached

Product ruling executed: the showcase now carries an **application-wide `Ctrl+I` shortcut** that toggles the "Allow remote control" checkbox (PR #160). It fires regardless of which child holds focus and drives the checkbox itself, so the policy path is the one a mouse click takes - no test-only backdoor. Verified directly before measuring: two local `Ctrl+I` presses produced `REMOTE_INPUT enabled` then `REMOTE_INPUT disabled`.

**Criterion correction, established by this run**: pointer evidence needs a **button event**. A remote `mouseMove` alone does not print `SHOWCASE_POINTER` on this payload; the repository's own showcase product-fit sends `mouseMove` + `mouseDown` + `mouseUp`, which is why it sees the line. So pointer absence after a bare move says nothing about delivery, while the keyboard line (`SHOWCASE_KEY`) is subject to focus.

| Step | Observed | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A - starting policy is view-only | fresh viewer connected (`SHOWCASE_CLIENTS 1`); remote pointer did **not** reach the application; keyboard line did **not** appear | **view-only blocked remote input**, agreed by two independent criteria |
| B - explicit local enablement | `local Ctrl+I: REMOTE_INPUT enabled observed on attempt 1`; the payload **restarted** remote access (`restarted: True`); fresh viewer connected; keyboard line **did** appear | **control mode delivers remote input**, and the entry is deterministic (one attempt, and it does not move focus, which is what produced the earlier false negatives) |
| C - policy back to view-only | `REMOTE_INPUT disabled NOT observed in 3 attempts` | **not reached** - the second `Ctrl+I` did not register while the session was live; cause not yet identified (window activation is the current candidate) |

**Honest status**: the cell is now **half observed**: view-only blocking holds (A) and control-mode delivery holds (B), both under a deterministic entry, but the **return to view-only (C) is still unobserved**. The accepted gap for held-state balance across the transition is unchanged (no key probe on this payload; adding one to the frozen candidate was declined).

**Also recorded**: the payload restarts remote access on every policy change (`stop()` -> `setRemoteInputEnabled()` -> `start()`), so a viewer opened before a change sits on a closed socket - each measurement here uses a fresh viewer, confirmed by the application reporting a connected client.
